name: MathOlympiad-Bench
intro: MathOlympiad-Bench 是 Goedel-Prover-V2 引入的人工核验 Lean 形式化奥林匹克数学基准。它包含来自 Compfiles 与 IMOSLLean4 的 360 道题，每题均配对一个形式定理和对应非形式化陈述并通过编译检查；证明模型以 Lean 接受结果计算 Pass@N，还可利用编译器反馈进行最多两轮自我修正。
build_method: 人工形式化, Lean 编译验证
eval_feature: 形式化证明, Lean 验证器, 验证器引导自我修正
eval_feature_en: Formal theorem proving, Lean verifier, verifier-guided self-correction
intro_en: MathOlympiad-Bench is the human-verified Lean-formalized olympiad benchmark introduced by Goedel-Prover-V2. It contains 360 problems from Compfiles and IMOSLLean4, each pairing one formal theorem with its informal statement and passing compilation checks; proof models are scored by Lean acceptance and Pass@N, with up to two compiler-feedback self-correction rounds.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.03613 Section 4.2 and the official Goedel-LM/MathOlympiadBench dataset card. The diagram preserves the Compfiles and IMOSLLean4 sources; the exact 158 IMO, 131 IMO Shortlist, 68 national-olympiad, and three-puzzle composition; human repair of incomplete, multi-file, multi-theorem, and Mathlib-incompatible records; exactly one Lean theorem paired with one informal statement; compilation with sorry; MiniF2F overlap checks; 360 human-verified items; Lean 4.9.0-rc1; 30,000-token whole-proof generation; up to two verifier-feedback repair rounds under a 40,000-token total budget; compiler acceptance; and Pass@N reporting.
